documents.name: Chartres en Lumières
documents.summary: A free, long-season night route transforming Chartres’ cathedral, churches, bridges and civic buildings with light and sound.
documents.whyWorthwhile: One of Europe’s strongest city-scale night environments: the architecture and public realm become a coherent visitor experience across an entire evening.

coreExperience.note: The illuminated route is predominantly visual.

weather.label: Dress for a long outdoor evening
weather.note: Cold or rain can materially shrink the route.

2026-season.note: The announced 2026 programme runs nightly in this window.

documents.name: Stelvio Pass Road — Bormio to Prato
documents.summary: A 44.6 km SS38 crossing from Bormio over the 2,758 m Stelvio Pass to Prato allo Stelvio.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Both sides are individually exceptional: the more enclosed Bormio approach contrasts with the exposed wall of switchbacks above Trafoi, producing a complete cross-pass journey rather than a one-sided climb.

documents.name: Three classic passes — Grimsel, Furka & Susten
documents.summary: A 131 km Swiss alpine loop from Meiringen linking the Grimsel, Furka and Susten passes in one continuous high-mountain circuit.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The route combines three major Swiss passes into one coherent circuit, moving through lake-and-waterfall country, glacier-facing high alpine terrain and long engineered mountain-road descents without requiring three separate out-and-back detours.
